subject: While CI is backlogged: post done once local gates + the smoke set pass twice; don't wait for CI. Reviews approve conditional on the first green CI run containing your sha
body: CI is about 2 h behind. Include the local evidence in your done message: gate output, smoke results run twice, db suites. The lead verifies (marks verified) only after a green CI run whose head contains your commit. If that run is red in your area, the task reopens.
